subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

Amenorrhea can cause a range of issues, including __infertility.__
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'.** i.e. **'Fecund'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Infertility" **(बांझपन) means the inability to conceive children or young.
 
• The **opposite** of** "infertility"** would be the ability to reproduce, which is** "fecund"** (उपजाऊ).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **'Fecund'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Stance"** (दृष्टिकोण) means a person’s way of standing, especially when deliberately adopted.
 
• **"Sterile"** (बाँझ) means incapable of producing offspring.
 
• **"Barrenness" **(बांझपन) is another term for infertility or unproductiveness.
